experiment: V69-G1 fresh same-domain generalization evaluation of three frozen candidates
status: evaluation only: no training, tuning, calibration, ensemble or threshold search
precision: CUDA backend: f32 storage and accumulation, matmul inputs possibly TF32 (autotune-selected); NOT strict FP32. Baseline inference is host-side f64.

candidates.A: d3/fits/A/final (D3-A update-12,000 checkpoint; model.mpk, meta.json; provenance d3/fits/A/provenance.json)
candidates.B: d1/baseline/model.json (D1 shallow logistic baseline with its original standardization and weights)

data.cells: 3 families x remaining budget {1,2} x class {neg,pos}
data.exclusion: connected groups sharing a canonical root or any immediate-child canonical identity with gen-001 (full 65-byte keys) are removed

controls.derangement: cyclic shift of keyed shuffle within family x budget cells (label independent, bijective, no fixed points); complete board instance replaced; recipient budget kept
controls.erasure: A,M: all 64 squares empty, budget/attacker-to-move/constant rule scalars kept; B: all board-derived base features replaced by fit means, budget indicator kept, interactions recomputed
